instruction: Create a presentation using all six images (pic1.png through pic6.png) from the Desktop. Build six blank slides and insert one image per slide in order: pic1.png on slide 1, pic2.png on slide 2, and so forth through pic6.png on slide 6. Ensure no text boxes or other content appear on the slides.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating 6 blank slides and inserting pic1.png through pic6.png in sequential order. Expected: 6 slides total, each with exactly 1 image. This is a paraphrased version of the original task with identical requirements.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: Image ordering not verified - Instruction requires 'pic1.png on slide 1, pic2.png on slide 2, etc.' but evaluator only counts images per slide without verifying which specific image file is on which slide. An agent could insert images in wrong order (e.g., pic6.png on slide 1) and still pass.

CRITICAL: Missing verification of 'no text boxes or other content' requirement - Instruction explicitly states 'Ensure no text boxes or other content appear on the slides', but evaluator only checks image counts. Slides could contain text boxes, shapes, or other elements and still pass.
Incomplete requirement coverage - Evaluator checks quantity (6 slides, 1 image each) but misses critical qualitative aspects (image identity/ordering, absence of non-image content).

Getter logic limitation - The getter extracts image counts using shape_type==13 (PICTURE) but doesn't extract image source/filename to verify ordering, nor does it check for other shape types to verify 'blank slides' requirement.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Extend getter to extract image filenames/sources for each slide (via shape.image.blob or shape.name) to enable verification of which image is on which slide
Extend getter to count all non-image shapes (text boxes, shapes, etc.) per slide to verify 'blank slides' requirement
Update metric to verify: (1) correct number of slides, (2) exactly 1 image per slide, (3) correct image ordering (pic1.png on slide 1, etc.), (4) no other content on slides

Update expected values to include image ordering specification (e.g., 'image_filenames': ['pic1.png', 'pic2.png', 'pic3.png', 'pic4.png', 'pic5.png', 'pic6.png']) and other_shapes_per_slide constraint (e.g., [0,0,0,0,0,0])
